# Maventri

> > Maventri provides comprehensive payroll, bookkeeping, HR, and CFO services for small businesses and specialized industries across multiple U.S. regions.

Maventri is a business services firm specializing in accounting, payroll processing, and human resources solutions. They serve diverse client bases including government contractors, non-profits, and cannabis companies, with regional expertise across Virginia, Maryland, Florida, Washington D.C., and Los Angeles.

- Bookkeeping Services

- CFO Consulting

- Government Contractors

- Cannabis Industry

- Payroll Management
